title: Customer-managed S3 onboarding: IAM role scanner, permissions validator, and test delivery
creator: Lena Huang
description: Scope: Build a self-serve onboarding flow that allows customers to register their own S3 bucket as a destination for scheduled usage exports. The flow must validate cross-account permissions, detect encryption / KMS constraints, optionally generate a least-privilege IAM role (on customer approval), and perform an end-to-end test delivery that writes a checksumed manifest and a small sample CSV. The backend components include: a permission scanner (assume-role validator + bucket policy analyzer), a role generator service (templated CloudFormation/IAM policy), a transient test-delivery worker that performs a safe write (default path: write to a prefixed 'redwood-exports/previews/tenant-<id>/'), and audit/event emission to export-audit and billing pipelines. The flow must never persist customer secrets; create ephemeral credentials only for the validation and test upload window. Provide clear user-facing error codes that map to remediation steps in the console (e.g., missing sts:AssumeRole trust, SCP deny, KMS key not shared). Fallback path: if customer does not want role creation, allow a manual verification path with signed PUT policy or console-provided presigned URL test upload. Deliverables: backend APIs, console wiring for the two-step onboarding UX, e2e tests, runbook for operator troubleshooting, and docs for customer success.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows 'S3 destination verified' and timestamp when assume-role + test upload succeed
Automated IAM role generator creates a minimal policy template and returns an ARN for customer to apply; system can validate that role afterwards
Test export writes a sample CSV and a _manifest.json with size+crc32 checksum to the customer bucket under a tenant-prefixed path
All success/failure outcomes emit events to export-audit (tenant id, target bucket, result code, error message) and to Datadog metrics with tags (tenant, region, verification_status)
No customer credentials are stored in plaintext; only ephemeral STS tokens kept in-memory for the validation window
KMS detection: if bucket uses a KMS key not shared to Redwood account, console surfaces exact remediation steps and links to KMS cross-account sharing docs
E2E integration tests in CI covering assume-role happy path, bucket-policy-only path, and KMS-blocked path
Operator runbook published with runbook playbook: 'how to reproduce validation failure', logs to check, and a mitigation checklist
work_log: 2026-02-24 - Initial proposal and spike: validated approach with product. Decided to support two verification modes: assume-role (recommended) and manual presigned-test (opt-in). Spike confirmed role generation feasible via CloudFormation template. - Lena

2026-03-01 - Design review: security team flagged auto-creation of IAM roles as high risk if done without explicit customer consent. Decision: role generator will produce a signed CloudFormation template and an optional one-click 'create role' flow that requires customer AWS console confirmation. - Marcus

2026-03-04 - Backend prototype: implemented permission scanner that attempts sts:AssumeRole and inspects bucket policy. Found edge cases where SCP denies assume-role leading to 403; added explicit error mapping for SCP denies. PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1542

2026-03-07 - QA discovered KMS cross-account errors when applying PutObject with kms:Encrypt. Added KMS detection logic and clearer remediation text (share key with Redwood account or use bucket-side SSE-S3). Created doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EX/Customer+S3+KMS+Guidance

2026-03-10 - UX: Console team provided mock for 2-step flow (role-arn copy + test delivery). Mock feedback: show checksum and signed-preview link on success. UI PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/812

2026-03-12 - Instrumentation: Datadog board created at https://app.datadoghq.com/dash/exports/s3-onboard-verification to track verification_count, verification_failures_by_reason, average_latency. Added trace spans to export-orchestrator 's3-verifier' path.

2026-03-14 - Security review kickoff scheduled. Noted requirement to add periodic revalidation if bucket lifecycle or role changes. Added follow-up ticket to implement scheduled re-checks after 30/90 days. - Marcus
notes: Trade-offs: fully automated role creation (CloudFormation + API apply) would reduce customer friction but increases blast radius if misconfigured. We opted for a customer-confirmation step.

Edge cases: GOV clouds and restricted accounts may not allow assume-role or external STS. Plan: detect region/account type and surface 'unsupported' with recommended alternatives (webhook/pull-based delivery).

Operational concerns: need quota limits on verification attempts to prevent abuse (rate-limit per tenant). Also add backpressure to the export-verifier worker pool to avoid sudden spikes during large onboarding drives.
Follow-ups: ENG-184512 (scheduled revalidation), PM-412 (billing adjustments for sample preview bytes), ENG-184523 (support for Azure Blob/GCS destinations)
